Cruise Pass

One internet package. The whole family in touch.

Cruise Pass adds internet delivery for your family's encrypted messages. When any one configured family phone gets online — a single Wi-Fi package, a port-day café, cellular ashore — it carries everyone's queued messages in both directions, including to family back home.

$9.99 · 30 days · one payment, no subscription · no-questions-asked refunds

How internet delivery works

What it's for

  1. Reach the people at homeGrandparents, the kid who stayed behind, anyone off the ship — messages flow to them through Cruise Pass, without buying internet for every phone on board.
  2. Port daysThe group scatters — some ashore, some on the ship. Any phone with any internet keeps the whole family's messages moving.
  3. When the ship Wi-Fi flakesOn-ship delivery over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth is free and needs no pass. Cruise Pass is the internet backstop when direct paths are unavailable.

How it works

  1. Pay by cardCheckout is handled by Stripe. Your card details never reach us.
  2. Get your setup linkChoose Open in CruiseMesh on the purchase result or in your email.
  3. Review and testCruiseMesh shows the service host, keeps the household secret hidden, and saves only after you confirm.
  4. Set up each family phoneOne pass covers the household. Each phone needs the setup link or QR; this does not add contacts or provide internet access.

Refunds: no questions asked

Every ship's network behaves differently, and you can't know exactly how yours will until you're on board. So if Cruise Pass doesn't work out on your sailing — for any reason — contact us within 90 days of purchase with your checkout email address and we'll refund the full amount. No questions asked.

What the relay can see

The relay stores sealed ciphertext only, for up to 30 days. It cannot read your messages, who sent them, or whether they were read. Details in the privacy policy.

Prefer to self-host?

CruiseMesh is open source, and the same relay runs on any small VPS — see the deployment guide. Cruise Pass exists for families who'd rather skip the server admin.
